name: Straight Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your left knee bent and left foot flat on the floor.
Extend your right leg straight out on the floor and flex your right foot upward.
Tighten the muscles on top of your right thigh so your knee is completely locked straight.
Maintaining that quad lock, lift your right leg roughly 12 inches off the floor until your thigh is parallel with your bent left thigh.
Hold for one to two seconds at the top, then slowly lower the straight leg back down to the floor.
coaching_cues: Your knee must stay completely straight during the entire lift; do not allow it to bend.
Keep your lower back flat on the mat without arching.
Perform smoothly and steadily without kicking.
